summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Dreamland Limited, a Hong Kong foreign private issuer, solely to report a change of its principal executive office address. The filing contains no financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or any event that qualifies as a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The report is a standard administrative update. Accordingly, it does not fall under any special-situations category.
